verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online Advanced mentions configurable custom workflows, and the product offers automated payment reminders. Both imply some time-based automation, but neither is documented as user-defined scheduling of recurring jobs. Evidence of rule-based automation exists, but nothing shows a scheduler, recurring-transaction setup, or a way for an agent or API to schedule jobs. Missing for 10: explicit recurring-job/workflow scheduling docs, schedule configuration (frequency, triggers), API or agent-accessible scheduling, independent hands-on corroboration.
